basic_details.job_title: PAU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline

qualification.details: B.E./ B.Tech./ B.Sc with a minimum of 60% marks or 6.00/ 10 OGPA. M.Tech in Processing & Food Engineering/ Food Engineering and Technology/ Post Harvest Engineering/ Food Science and Technology or equivalent with a minimum of 65% marks or 6.50/ 10 OGPA. Cleared a National level exam such as CSIR/ UGC/ NET/ GATE/ MHRD, etc. Ph.D. holders are eligible without a Master's degree in the relevant subject. Non-NET candidates with M.Tech/ M.Sc may be appointed at Rs. 30000 + 18% HRA.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for PAU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https:/ / www.pau.edu.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 22-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Junior Research Fellow post at Punjab Agricultural University is 22nd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37000 per month, plus 18% HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc with at least 60% marks or an M.Tech in relevant fields with 65% marks, and must have cleared a national-level exam like NET or GATE.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by sending the completed form to the address specified in the official notification before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the PAU Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 200 for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Junior Research Fellow position will be held on 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Does PAU offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow position at Punjab Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University, the link for which is provided in the Important Links section.
